split_policy.basis: same 3010 ordered JPX sessions as PR #10

exit_diagnostic.mfe_mae_denominator: entry fill price including entry commission
exit_diagnostic.mfe_mae_exit_session_path_convention: conservative executable path: gap exits use only the opening print; stop exits use the opening print and stop trigger; take-profit-only exits order the non-stop Low before the take trigger; prices after the frozen trigger are excluded

capacity_diagnostic.quality_comparison: accepted versus capacity_rejected on capacity-binding sessions

drawdown_diagnostic.episode_definition: non-overlapping running-watermark peak to first recovery
drawdown_diagnostic.ranking: drawdown ascending then peak date then trough date

regime_proxy_definitions.active_member_denominator: security-session rows with universe_member=true and a valid adjusted Close
regime_proxy_definitions.active_member_weekly_above_200ma_share: daily arithmetic mean of weekly_above_200ma over the active-member denominator
regime_proxy_definitions.active_member_macd_uptrend_share: daily arithmetic mean of weekly_macd_uptrend over the active-member denominator
regime_proxy_definitions.cross_sectional_return: one-ticker-session adjusted Close divided by its immediately preceding valid ticker-session adjusted Close minus one
regime_proxy_definitions.cross_sectional_median_adjusted_return: daily median of cross_sectional_return over active members with a finite return
regime_proxy_definitions.cross_sectional_adjusted_return_populati: daily population standard deviation with ddof=0 over active members with a finite return
regime_proxy_definitions.signal_breadth: daily raw frozen entry-signal count divided by active-member count
regime_proxy_definitions.cash_utilization: frozen primary curve market value divided by equity
regime_proxy_definitions.period_aggregation: arithmetic mean of available daily proxy values inside the inclusive period
regime_proxy_definitions.drawdown_ticker_and_sector_contribution: anonymous gross-negative position-day PnL concentration plus net position-day PnL contribution; position-day totals must reconcile to the frozen equity curve
regime_proxy_definitions.drawdown_score_and_exit_contribution: gross-negative position-day PnL shares, with every position-day assigned to the trade's frozen final exit-reason group
regime_proxy_definitions.signal_frequency: raw signal count per 100 JPX sessions

A_ADDED_SIGNAL_QUALITY.left_arm: ADDED_CODE frozen one-shot closed shadow outcomes inside each expanded universe
A_ADDED_SIGNAL_QUALITY.right_arm: U15_STATIC_CODE frozen one-shot closed shadow outcomes inside the same expanded universe
A_ADDED_SIGNAL_QUALITY.estimand: trade-weighted mean net-return difference, left minus right

B_CAPACITY_PRIORITY.left_arm: capacity_rejected frozen one-shot closed shadow outcomes
B_CAPACITY_PRIORITY.right_arm: accepted candidates on the same capacity-binding entry sessions
B_CAPACITY_PRIORITY.estimand: trade-weighted mean net-return difference, left minus right

C_HIGH_EXPOSURE.high_exposure_definition: frozen primary cash_utilization at signal session is at least 0.80
C_HIGH_EXPOSURE.estimand: trade-weighted mean net-return difference, left minus right
C_HIGH_EXPOSURE.drawdown_support_required: expanded-universe maximum drawdown is worse than U15 adjusted in both validation and final_holdout

D_EXIT_ATTRIBUTION.negative_exit_burden: 1 for stop_loss, stop_gap, or a negative max_holding outcome; otherwise 0
D_EXIT_ATTRIBUTION.left_arm: ADDED_CODE frozen one-shot closed shadow outcomes inside each expanded universe
D_EXIT_ATTRIBUTION.right_arm: U15_STATIC_CODE frozen one-shot closed shadow outcomes inside the same expanded universe
D_EXIT_ATTRIBUTION.estimand: trade-weighted mean negative-exit-burden difference, left minus right
D_EXIT_ATTRIBUTION.scope: association only; no alternative exit is tested

E_SCORE_MONOTONICITY.right_arm: pooled Score 90 and Score 100 closed accepted trades
E_SCORE_MONOTONICITY.estimand: trade-weighted mean net-return difference, left minus right

diagnostic_hypothesis_estimands.bootstrap: resample the union of signal YYYY-MM clusters with replacement; retain every closed trade in each sampled cluster and recompute the trade-weighted arm means
diagnostic_hypothesis_estimands.leave_one_out: repeat the same mean-difference estimand after excluding each ticker bucket and each sector bucket; all buckets must remain evaluable and preserve direction

cause_classification_policy.two_or_more_actionable_hypotheses: F_MULTIPLE_FACTORS; expose no more than the first two by pre-registered priority

verdict_policy.ACTIONABLE_DIAGNOSTIC_HYPOTHESIS: at least one hypothesis satisfies every robust-hypothesis condition
verdict_policy.NO_ACTIONABLE_DIAGNOSTIC_HYPOTHESIS: at least one candidate is fully evaluable and none passes
verdict_policy.DATA_OR_SAMPLE_INSUFFICIENT: all candidate hypotheses are unevaluable because required data or samples are insufficient

runtime_policy.control_plane_exception: git fetch/push and GitHub Draft-PR publication explicitly required by the gate are outside diagnostic runtime counters
